data.name: VSG_001
data.value: The mist is even thicker here...[pause=15] It's almost unreal.

data.name: VSG_002
data.value: This is the heart of the steppe.[pause=20] Something must be protecting this place.

data.name: VSG_003
data.value: Its crescent horn...[pause=10] it's glowing!

data.name: VSG_004
data.value: The Warden of the Plains awakens...

data.name: VSG_005
data.value: That voice again!

data.name: VSG_006
data.value: The oldest of omens.[pause=20] He will not yield so easily.

data.name: VSG_007
data.value: Prove your worth, traveler...

data.name: VSG_008
data.value: This is the last obstacle before the end of the steppe![pause=10] Let's go!

data.name: VSG_009
data.value: We're charging back in.[pause=15] This time, we've got this!

data.name: VSG_010
data.value: We defeated the guardian of the steppe!

data.name: VSG_011
data.value: The mist is starting to clear...

data.name: VSG_012
data.value: That voice...[pause=15] It knew he was here.

data.name: VSG_013
data.value: We'll find answers later.[pause=20] Let's move forward.

data.name: VSG_014
data.value: The Warden shows no mercy to the weak.

data.name: VSG_015
data.value: Go back where you came from.[pause=30] Return when you are ready.

data.name: VSG_016
data.value: We...[pause=10] we can't do this![pause=15] He's too powerful!

data.name: VSG_017
data.value: The Warden lowers its head.[pause=20] Its crescent horn emits one last glow.

data.name: VSG_018
data.value: You are not ready yet, traveler.[pause=30] But you have heart.

data.name: VSG_019
data.value: The Alpha watches you leave without moving.[pause=25] It returns to watching over the steppe.

data.name: VSG_020
data.value: The Warden collapses with a deep rumble.[pause=15] The mist around him dissipates.

data.name: VSG_021
data.value: Its crescent horn fades slowly.[pause=20] It looks at you with... respect?

data.name: VSG_022
data.value: You are worthy, stranger.[pause=25] The steppe is yours.

data.name: VSG_023
data.value: It vanishes into the mist, leaving behind a peaceful silence.

data.name: VSG_024
data.value: We defeated the Warden...[pause=15] We really did it.

data.name: VSG_025
data.value: Even the greatest wardens eventually bow.[pause=25] You are progressing.

data.name: VSG_026
data.value: You have calmed the watcher of the grasses. The burning mountain will judge the rest of your path.

data.name: VSG_027
data.value: The burning mountain... the Searing Tunnel! That's where the expedition makes camp!

data.name: VSG_028
data.value: An Absol...[pause=15] They say it appears when a disaster draws near.

data.name: VSG_029
data.value: Its crescent horn is older than the grass.[pause=15] Older than the path we took.

data.name: VSG_030
data.value: You may still turn back. No one would hold it against you.

data.name: VSG_031
data.value: We'd hold it against ourselves. That's enough.

data.name: VSG_032
data.value: Then stop talking and stand up straight. It's coming.

data.name: VSG_033
data.value: It bows its head — not in defeat. In greeting.

data.name: VSG_034
data.value: Did it just... say goodbye?

data.name: VSG_035
data.value: I think it said 'go on'. It's not the same thing.

data.name: VSG_036
data.value: The mist is thinning. I can see the ridge line at last.

data.name: VSG_037
data.value: And smoke behind it. That's where we're headed, isn't it.

data.name: VSG_R01
data.value: The grass has grown back over the whole clearing.[pause=20] Not a single trace left.

data.name: VSG_R02
data.value: (He stood right there.[pause=15] The ground doesn't remember him at all.)

data.name: VSG_R03
data.value: The warden has moved on.[pause=20] I suppose the steppe no longer needs watching.

data.name: VSG_R04
data.value: Nothing more to find here.[pause=0] Time to head home.

data.name: VSG_038
data.value: You came back.[pause=30] They always come back.

data.name: VSG_039
data.value: I have stood in this mist longer than your town has had a name.

data.name: VSG_040
data.value: Long enough to notice when the mist began to taste wrong.

data.name: VSG_041
data.value: Something under the grass stopped sleeping.[pause=30] Years ago now.

data.name: VSG_042
data.value: I cannot follow it. This plain shaped me.[pause=25] It keeps me.[pause=25] Not you.

data.name: VSG_043
data.value: So I will do the only useful thing an old guardian can do.[pause=30] I will get out of your way —[pause=20] once you prove you are worth the road.

data.name: VSG_044
data.value: Good.[pause=30] I am tired, and you are not.

data.name: VSG_045
data.value: Take the plain. Take the smoke beyond it.[pause=25] Take whatever is under them both.

data.name: VSG_046
data.value: And small one —[pause=25] the mist has never spoken to me.[pause=30] Ask yourself why it speaks to you.
